exposure: Length of state-level eviction moratoria (0 months, 1-2 months, 3-4 months, 5 or more months)
cohort: The study included 375,821 births of individuals with Medicaid or no insurance who conceived in March-May 2020 in the United States.
finding: State-level eviction moratoria lasting 5 or more months were associated with a slightly reduced risk of preterm birth and low birthweight outcomes, though these associations may be explained by residual state-level confounding.
mod_finding: There was no association between eviction moratoria and primary cesarean.
